summary: APP REVIEW application - Comment list management system with form submission, list display, and backend storage. Fixing non-functional submit button, automatic list population, button click handlers, and performance optimization.
architectural_notes: React + TypeScript frontend with proper state management
Motoko backend canister for persistent storage of comment lists
Navigation system with Customer View, Upload Section, and Live List Checker buttons
Form submission system for creating new comment lists
Dropdown component for managing existing lists
known_issues: Submit button ('Choose a list...') not responding to clicks
New comment lists not appearing in 'Manage Existing Lists' dropdown
Button click handlers not triggering properly throughout app
Performance issues causing slow response times

existing_features.title: Fix the 'Choose a list...' button in the 'Create New Comment List' section so that clicking it successfully creates a new comment list with the entered name (e.g., 'App7') and triggers the backend storage operation
Make newly created comment lists automatically appear in the 'Manage Existing Lists' dropdown immediately after creation without requiring a page refresh
Fix all button click event handlers throughout the Admin Panel to ensure they respond properly when clicked in production deployment
Optimize frontend performance to reduce response time and eliminate UI glitches, particularly focusing on form submission and list rendering operations
Clear the list name input field after successfully creating a new comment list to allow immediate creation of another list
